project_type: PostgreSQL database project (Supabase-hosted) - PERFECCITY MVP BOM platform
build_system: Supabase MCP apply_migration for DDL changes, git for version control
test_framework: SQL regression harness (DO $$ blocks with RAISE NOTICE/EXCEPTION pattern), run via psql or Supabase execute_sql
build_command: N/A - DDL applied via Supabase MCP apply_migration tool
test_command: Execute tests/regression_v1.1.5.sql via Supabase execute_sql or psql
verification_instructions: 1. Apply migration via Supabase MCP apply_migration. 2. Verify RLS enabled on all 34 tables via pg_tables query. 3. Run RLS-specific test harness to confirm policies work correctly. 4. Run get_advisors security check to confirm no new RLS warnings for perfecity schema.
setup_instructions: No local setup needed - all changes applied to live Supabase project fbiemsbykrmrbqcsobvh via MCP tools
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. Supabase MCP tools available (apply_migration, execute_sql, list_tables, get_advisors). No local psql needed. The perfecity schema is NOT currently exposed to PostgREST (authenticated/anon roles lack USAGE). The migration must GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA perfecity to authenticated and grant SELECT on appropriate tables.
contribution_requirements: Migration files go in migrations/ directory in the repo. Must also be applied to live Supabase via apply_migration MCP tool. Branch: feat/db-baseline-v1.1.5. Must push after changes.
key_patterns: Auth model: auth.uid() for user identity, auth.jwt()->'app_metadata'->>'role' for role. Roles: ADMIN, DESIGNER, CONSULTANT, SYSTEM. created_by UUID columns link to auth.uid(). Templates owned by DESIGNER, Projects owned by CONSULTANT. Master data ADMIN-write/all-read. service_role bypasses RLS. Triggers use SECURITY DEFINER functions (already exist). 34 tables in perfecity schema.
directory_structure: baseline/ - authoritative DDL, migrations/ - incremental patches, tests/ - regression harness SQL, docs/ - runbooks and guides, ci/ - CI runner scripts
